changes: p2 name corrected from 'Kṛṣṇavāṇaka' to 'Kṛṣṇa': 'vāṇaka' is very likely a corrupt 'gaṇaka' (an occupational title), so it is moved to titles. This fits the first reading's own note and the known author Kṛṣṇa Daivajña, son of Ballāla.
p2 confidence lowered to medium because the name rests on an emendation.
p1 Vallāla kept as relative_only (father of the commentator). Ballāla is noted as the usual spelling.
Notes expanded: there are no copy-specific persons, date or place.

notes: This is only a section colophon ('karaṇisaḍvidhavipa(!)raṇaṃ' = karaṇīṣaḍvidhavivaraṇam) from the Bījavivṛtikalpalatāvatāra (Bījapallava/Bījāṅkura), Kṛṣṇa Daivajña's commentary on Bhāskara's Bījagaṇita. It names only the commentator and the commentator's father, Ballāla (written vallāla). The 'kṛṣṇavāṇaka' in the colophon is most likely a scribal corruption of 'kṛṣṇagaṇaka'. The colophon gives no scribe, owner, date or place for this copy.
